Call for Papers: 24th Asian Law Institute Conference

The 24th Asian Law Institute Conference will be held at the National University of Singapore on 28–29 May 2027. The theme is Law and Society in Asia.

Abstracts of no more than 500 words should be submitted by 15 December 2026. Keynote addresses will be given by Professor Jane Doe and Professor Li Wei.
